title: US Raises Saudi Arabia Travel Advisory to Level 3 Over Houthi Missile Attacks
detail: The United States raised its travel advisory for Saudi Arabia to Level 3 ('Reconsider Travel'), warning American citizens to reconsider travel to the Saudi-Yemen border region amid ongoing Houthi missile attacks. The advisory reflects heightened concerns over cross-border strikes targeting Saudi territory.
